[Intro]
(gentle solo piano, sparse and warm)

[Verse 1]
Closer by one cup of coffee.
Slower Than Before is only the name I give this hour.
A window holds Slower Than Before a little longer.

[Pre-Chorus]
Slower Than Before begins when the first line does.
I notice closer by one cup of coffee before the room does.

[Chorus]
The piano says closer by one cup of coffee more quietly than I do.
I stay with Slower Than Before and do not rename it.
The evening keeps Slower Than Before and nothing larger.

[Verse 2]
I say Slower Than Before once, then let the notes finish.
Closer by one cup of coffee.

[Piano Solo]
(expressive melodic piano solo, sustained and tender)

[Bridge]
A window holds Slower Than Before a little longer.
Slower Than Before begins when the first line does.

[Chorus]
The piano says closer by one cup of coffee more quietly than I do.
I stay with Slower Than Before and do not rename it.
The evening keeps Slower Than Before and nothing larger.

[Outro]
(solo piano fades into soft residual notes)
Slower Than Before is only the name I give this hour.
